question: What was the total GST revenue collection recorded in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.95 lakh crore rupees.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **In January 2025, the Gross GST revenue collection stood at 1.95 lakh crore rupees.**
 
• **This marks a 12.3% growth compared to January 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central GST (CGST) collection for January 2025 was 36,077 crore rupees.
 
• The State GST (SGST) collection amounted to 44,942 crore rupees.
 
• The Integrated GST (IGST) collection was over 1 lakh crore rupees.
 
• The cess collection stood at 13,412 crore rupees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST)**__

 __
 
• GST is a comprehensive indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services in India.
 
• It was implemented on July 1, 2017, replacing multiple indirect taxes.
 
• GST is categorized into CGST (Central GST), SGST (State GST), IGST (Integrated GST), and cess.
 
 
 
• **State-wise Growth in GST Collection**__
 __
 
• Ladakh recorded the highest GST growth of 39%.
 
• Nagaland and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands saw a 26% increase in GST revenue.
 
 
 
• **GST Council**__
 
 
• The GST Council is responsible for making decisions on tax rates, exemptions, and revenue sharing.
 
• It is chaired by the Union Finance Minister of India.
